title: An archive of a lane is refused while that lane pushed a branch with no PR
why: A lane that pushes a branch with no PR and says done leaves work that no runner will ever batch.
note: Topic guards. Extends the guard of step lane-closes-after-records. Incident: q_max lane qmax-hosted-db-probe-gate pushed claude/qmax-hosted-db-gate-notes with no PR and said done (19:28 CST Nov 7); the coordinator told it to open a draft PR for runner 9. Filed from the coordinator, 19:28 CST Nov 7.
